sources_tested: Exact BHG/title/edition searches; Digital Walters W.521 description and viewer; Bollandist publication record; local licensed-corpus and scan-register checks; targeted external searches for the Michaea/Baltimore recension.
open_text_result: No licensed open transcription of Halkin’s exact BHGn 1281e recension was located. General texts about the prophet Micah were excluded as non-equivalent.
scan_result: Exact manuscript provenance is established by the Canon’s W.521 reference and the public Walters description for the January Imperial Menologion. The item-level folio range was not returned by the authoritative sources searched, so no target image subset is cleared.
scan_rights: Digital Walters documents CC0 availability for eligible manuscript images and high-resolution TIFF delivery. That volume-level policy does not replace a folio-level mapping; no image was fetched.
next_action: Find the W.521 table of contents, TEI, or manifest entry for BHGn 1281e and record the exact folios before any remote scan transfer.
notes: This notice is distinct from other Micah hagiographic or exegetical texts. The actual item-level search yielded no open text and no reliable page mapping; no OCR was used.
